items.exampleEn: You can use a calculator on the math test.
items.exampleZh: 數學考試可以用計算機。

items.exampleEn: Please put the dirty plates in the dishwasher.
items.exampleZh: 請把髒盤子放進洗碗機。

items.exampleEn: The school bought new science equipment.
items.exampleZh: 學校買了新的科學設備。

items.exampleEn: I change the sheets on my bed every week.
The water tank on the roof is empty.
We cook soup in a big pot.
The iron is too hot to touch.
Don't touch that wire; it's dangerous.

items.sentenceEn: Can you give me a sheet of paper?

items.audioEn: The dishwasher is broken, so we have to wash the dishes by hand tonight.
items.audioZh: 洗碗機壞了，所以我們今晚得用手洗碗。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful; the iron is still hot.
The fish tank in the living room needs cleaning.
items.sentenceZh: 客廳的魚缸需要清洗了。

items.stemEn: Fill the ____ with water and put it on the stove.
items.stemZh: 把鍋子裝滿水，放到爐子上。

items.stemEn: Please ____ this shirt before you wear it to the interview.
items.stemZh: 穿這件襯衫去面試之前，請先燙一燙。

items.passageEn: We just moved into a new apartment. The kitchen already has a dishwasher and a large hot water tank, but we had to buy everything else: pots, plates, and an iron. Prices were relatively high, so my father used a calculator to check every bill. A worker came to fix a loose wire in the bedroom. My brother brought his gym equipment, and it fills the whole balcony. Finally, we put clean sheets on the beds and slept well.
items.passageZh: 我們剛搬進一間新公寓。廚房裡原本就有洗碗機和一個大熱水箱，但其他東西都得買：鍋子、盤子，還有熨斗。東西相對貴，所以爸爸用計算機核對每一張帳單。一位工人來修臥室一條鬆掉的電線。我的兄弟把他的健身器材搬來，塞滿了整個陽台。最後，我們鋪上乾淨的床單，睡了個好覺。

referenceEn: I iron my clothes every Sunday evening.
Every Sunday night, I iron my clothes.
rubricZh: 說習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受
時間片語可放在句首、句尾等位置

items.promptZh: 這間健身房的器材都很新。
referenceEn: All the equipment in this gym is new.
The equipment in this gym is all new.
rubricZh: 用 equipment 表示「器材」（不可數，動詞用單數，例如 is new）
